lines.text: Cloudflare sends every DNS change to its servers worldwide. Some domains have over twenty million records.
Before, even a small setting change could rebuild the whole domain. That was slow and used lots of memory.
lines.title: Old way vs new way

lines.text: A planner picks the smallest rebuild it can prove is safe. If it is unsure, it still does the full rebuild.
lines.title: The planner

lines.text: A scheduler merges several changes for one domain into a single job, so work is not repeated.
lines.title: Key parts

lines.text: Peak memory fell by eighty-five percent. Almost all builds now avoid rebuilding the full domain.
lines.title: Results

lines.text: The median wait from a change to being written dropped from about seven point seven seconds to three point three.
lines.title: Median delay

lines.text: Do less work, but only when you can prove it is safe. When unsure, do the full job.
lines.title: Takeaways
